limitations: LCP is the final candidate after the load event plus a fixed 2000 ms observation window, before any catalog or search input.

Usability timestamps are the first animation frame containing the real visible control with application prerequisites; functionality is independently exercised after the first-screen metrics are captured.
Local identity/no-store HTTP transport is matched across phases; these are not a CDN or production-host benchmark.
CDP wire encodedDataLength includes protocol headers; Resource Timing encodedBodySize and decodedBodySize are also recorded separately.
completionMeaning: complete means five measurements captured real LCP, navigation and functional title/directory timings. success separately requires no observed network failure or page error.
